summary: Added a protected course-video browser on Veyra’s existing port 3000, bypassing the unresolved port 8090 connection problem.
instructions: On your iPhone open /videos/ at the same Veyra address used for chat (http://192.168.1.9:3000/videos/), or tap Course videos in the chat navigation. Open a course folder and tap an MP4 to play; try seeking within the video. Uses the existing Veyra network sign-in. The course folder was verified to exist with 385 MP4 files. Tested directory browsing, shared UI-update injection, range responses, HEAD, sign-in enforcement, missing files, and path restrictions; all 32 web-chat tests also passed. iPhone playback still needs your confirmation. No firewall rules changed, and the original 8090 cause remains unconfirmed. The separate unauthenticated port 8090 server and router forwarding were not changed; disable the forwarding if public sharing is not intended.
